decision.WebTransport: Reject for current release: no justified browser/server caller requiring it; direct peer caller uses WebRTC and selected server caller has bounded WSS evidence.
decision.nativeQUIC: Defer as future research: no named caller or implemented common native integration. Platform API availability does not establish product support.

limits: This records the missing caller/retain/reject decision. No same-workload supported-runtime, security or end-to-end candidate comparison was executed; whole T13 remains open. No accepted support row added.
reconsider: Name a workload and measurable requirement not met by incumbents before implementing or benchmarking an optional candidate.
